# WF22 · Thu ngân · có đơn đã duyệt

Group **WF · Thu ngân & lên đơn** · state · Next.js: **built (U5)** (`/cashier`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/order-ui.js#history`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/operations-ui.js#printOrder`
- Cashier is `operations-ui.js › cashier()`; the quick-order dialog and the order history are `order-ui.js`; the A5 review page is `order-review/index.html` + `order-review.js`; data and rules are `order-data.js`.
- `order-ui.js › history()` for an approved order: the row reads "… · 2 sản phẩm · Đã duyệt" and carries only "Xem / in" (no "Sửa nháp"). `operations-ui.js › cashier()` shows the invoice row with the order code and "In tách đơn" (`data-ops="print-order"` → `printOrder` → `PemaOrderUI.preview`, opens the review page in a new tab).
- Stats: Tổng hóa đơn 49, Còn phải thu 11.970.500 ₫ (11.250.000 + 720.500, the total of the two products).
- Inventory note: Approved order: only "Xem / in" (no "Sửa nháp"); the invoice row carries the order code and "In tách đơn" (data-ops print-order, opens the review page in a new tab).
- Page key `cashier` is allowed for roles: owner, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- Controls removed for roles without the capability: `ops=pay` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant); `ops=quick-order` needs `billing` (roles owner/accountant).
- How to reach it in the old web: {"block":"http://127.0.0.1:4174/**"} → {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"cashier\"]"} → {"click":"[data-ops=\"quick-order\"]"} → {"wait":"#catalog-order-form"} → {"click":"[data-quick-add=\"H002\"]"} → {"click":"[data-quick-add=\"H005\"]"} → {"fill":["#usage-0","Bôi lớp mỏng, sáng và tối, 14 ngày"]} → {"fill":["#usage-1","Bôi lớp mỏng, sáng và tối, 14 ngày"]} → {"clickPopup":"#quick-save"} → {"wait":"#approve"} → {"click":"#approve"} → {"wait":"body[data-approved=\"true\"]"} → {"main":true} → {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}&screen=cashier"} → {"wait":".order-history-row"}; it must show "Đã duyệt".

## Business rules
- "AI chỉ là bản nháp" principle for orders: a draft needs the responsible doctor's approval before it is printed or shown in the patient app ("Đơn nháp cần bác sĩ duyệt trước khi in.").

## Differences from the app design
- App F6 lists "DN-1 · Đã duyệt" with the two sheets and "Xem bố cục hai phiếu A5"; the web row has "Xem / in" and the cashier link "In tách đơn".
